heading_path: Part 10—Assignment and transmission of trade marks
10.1  Applications for assignment etc to be recorded or entered
text: For the purposes of paragraphs 107(2)(b) and 109(2)(b) of the Act (which deal with assignment and transmission), the following documents are prescribed: (a) a document that establishes the title to a trade mark of the assignee, or of the person to whom the trade mark has been transmitted; (b) evidence in writing of consent of the Commission to the assignment of a certification trade mark.
